import math

def build_agent(sandbox):
    # Define key anchor points and peak
    left_anchor = (6.3, 0.0)
    right_anchor = (13.7, 0.0)
    peak = (10.0, 5.0)  # Reduced height to minimize torque

    # Left sloped beam
    dx_left = peak[0] - left_anchor[0]
    dy_left = peak[1] - left_anchor[1]
    beam_length_left = math.hypot(dx_left, dy_left)
    left_x = left_anchor[0] + dx_left / 2
    left_y = left_anchor[1] + dy_left / 2
    left_beam = sandbox.add_beam(left_x, left_y, beam_length_left, 0.4,
                                 angle=math.atan2(dy_left, dx_left), density=1.0)

    # Right sloped beam
    dx_right = peak[0] - right_anchor[0]
    dy_right = peak[1] - right_anchor[1]
    beam_length_right = math.hypot(dx_right, dy_right)
    right_x = right_anchor[0] + dx_right / 2
    right_y = right_anchor[1] + dy_right / 2
    right_beam = sandbox.add_beam(right_x, right_y, beam_length_right, 0.4,
                                  angle=math.atan2(dy_right, dx_right), density=1.0)

    # Anchor columns to the ground
    sandbox.add_joint(left_beam, None, left_anchor, type='rigid')
    sandbox.add_joint(right_beam, None, right_anchor, type='rigid')

    # Connect sloped beams at the peak
    sandbox.add_joint(left_beam, right_beam, peak, type='rigid')
